hero.eyebrow: Micro-label above main heading (e.g., 'Direct access, no account layer'). Max 6 words.

h1.h1-text: Role title prefix (e.g., 'Hire a RAG developer:').
h1.span: Targeted expertise or sub-specialization (e.g., 'freelance retrieval-augmented generation engineer'). Max 6 words.

hero.hero-sub: Introductory paragraph stating the engineer's persona, role scope, core deliverables (RAG pipelines, assistants, production deployment), and engineering guarantees. Exactly 2-3 sentences.

cred.b: Cred highlight text (e.g., '5+ yrs AI & ML systems', '20+ projects shipped', '48h written spec'). Max 5 words.

btn-primary.text: Direct hire CTA button text (e.g., 'Hire me directly'). Max 4 words.

btn-ghost.text: Secondary proof button text (e.g., 'View case studies'). Max 4 words.

hero.live: Availability and onboarding trust signal (e.g., 'Start in 48 to 72 hours, no team overhead, no account manager'). Exactly 1 sentence.

trust.span: Metric label (e.g., 'Years building AI & ML systems', 'Projects shipped to production', 'To a written technical spec'). Max 5 words.
